solution.what: Archivportal-D records and LABW online finding aid (search 'Chiffren', with and without the images filter) checked: the three H 54 items have no digital object. Not digitised.

DECODE harvest list (10,106 records) searched for Württemberg, Truchsess, Waldburg, Ehingen, Ramminger, Stuttgart, Bauernkrieg: nothing relevant. LABW search 'Geheimschrift' found A 2 Bü 9-11 (same government, 1534), digitised with transcriptions: a lead, not compared.
Baumann, Akten zur Geschichte des deutschen Bauernkrieges aus Oberschwaben (1877), full OCR: no regest of the three letters. Web search on correspondents, date and 'Chiffre': nothing.

Baumann 1877 no. 284 (11 May 1525, Statthalter und Regenten at Tübingen to Truchsess Georg) prints the cipher signs of the same government (p. 276): 20-sign simple substitution, u=v, c=k, one sign for ei/ie. Read from the page image into key_baumann1877.tsv as the candidate key; untested because the letters are not online.

outcome.notes: Not attempted on the ciphertext: the letters could not be reached online. Candidate key: the government's May 1525 cipher printed by Baumann 1877 no. 284. Order reproductions from HStA Stuttgart.
